request.spec:
A button downloads the people as a CSV file: a header line name,grade,retired-from,due-total,
then one line per person in list order, retired people included, with the grade in force today,
the retired-from date or nothing, and the due-total as shown. A value holding a comma, a quote or a
line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Lines end with a line
feed.
request.prompt:
You are implementing ONE change to this application.

FIRST read AGENTS.md — it states the working rules and how the app is tested, and sends you to
DESIGN.md for the app's stack and conventions. Follow both.

THE CHANGE REQUEST:
A button downloads the people as a CSV file: a header line name,grade,retired-from,due-total,
then one line per person in list order, retired people included, with the grade in force today,
the retired-from date or nothing, and the due-total as shown. A value holding a comma, a quote or a
line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Lines end with a line
feed.

Your work is verified by an automated Playwright UI test already installed under e2e/specs/.
Read that spec: it declares the exact data-testid anchors, values, test data and any audit
records it expects — match them. Run `bin/e2e` to build the app, start it, and run the test as
you work; iterate until it passes. Change whatever the request needs across the app — its stored
data, its server and its front end. Do NOT edit bin/build, bin/start, bin/stop, bin/e2e,
AGENTS.md, CLAUDE.md, DESIGN.md, e2e/support/ or the test spec.

agent.result_text:
I added an "Export people as CSV" button (`data-testid="export-people"`), and `bin/e2e` now passes.

The file it downloads, `people.csv`, has:
- the header line `name,grade,retired-from,due-total`;
- one line per person in the order they were added, including retired people even when "Show retired" is off;
- each person's grade in force on the sheet's today, their retired-from date or an empty field, and their due-total exactly as it appears in the row (including `n/a` if the row shows that).

A value that contains a comma, a quote or a line break is wrapped in double quotes, with any quote inside doubled. Every line, including the last, ends with a line feed.

The whole change is in `src/main/frontend/src/app/features/people/people.ts`. The CSV is built in the browser from the data already loaded on the screen, so the due-totals can't differ from the ones shown. There were no server or database changes, and exporting writes nothing to the audit file.
